h2_status: NOT CONFIRMED as a uniform null; partial evidence against; NOT formally falsified. The registered >=2-independent-datasets premise is unmet: T2 is a surrogate in-silico construct built on three independent embryo atlases but keyed to the same 44 VCC validation target genes as T3 (whose ground truth is the published VCC validation DE table); a computational surrogate is not an independent real perturbation dataset. W6 cross-atlas replication shows the direction-magnitude dissociation is stable across three held-out atlases but does not convert T2 into an independent real dataset. 'Stably outperforms the baselines' does not hold across DES/PDS/MAE or against both baselines. scGPT's directional advantage and magnitude failure are reported with equal prominence. No post-scoring test added, no preregistered criterion changed, no third OSF update. reasons: T2 is a surrogate in-silico construct built from three independent embryo atlases but keyed to the same 44 VCC validation target genes as T3, whose ground truth is the published VCC validation DE table; the two tasks do not constitute >=2 independent perturbational datasets. W6 cross-atlas replication shows stable direction-magnitude dissociation across three held-out atlases but does not convert a surrogate into a real dataset.
'Stably outperforms the baselines' is not satisfied across all registered primary metrics (DES, PDS, MAE) or against both mandatory baselines.
Registered permutation null tests each method against permuted rows, not the model-versus-baseline contrast; paired effect sizes with bootstrap CIs are the primary comparison.
T3 scGPT DES is below train_mean and its DES contrast CI lower bound (0.04977) falls below delta2 = 0.05.
